$comment: Generated from lib/cloze-schema.ts by `npm run generate:schemas` — do not edit by hand.
title: Cloze Exercise YAML
description: Schema for a cloze exercise ("Fill the gaps"): one text whose gaps students complete, graded per gap with consolidated feedback.

id.description: Short machine-readable exercise id, e.g. future-forms-sue.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for the teacher's lists (not shown to students).

title.description: Optional heading shown to students above the task (default: "Fill the gaps").

description.description: Optional task shown to students in a box above the text (Markdown), e.g. which forms to use.

fragment_files.description: Optional fragment libraries this exercise pulls shared prompt fragments from.

text_files.description: Optional plain-text files (markdown / source) embedded verbatim into instructions via {{file "alias"}} markers.

instructions.description: Optional preamble prepended to BOTH the grading prompt and the feedback prompt (e.g. a language policy). SERVER-ONLY. When any fragment_files or text_files are declared, place fragments inline with {{fragment "alias.id" …}} and embed text files with {{file "alias"}} (optionally {{file "alias" from=10 to=40}} for a line range; escape a literal {{ as \{{).

evaluation.description: The grading criteria for the WHOLE exercise: its goal, and how far an answer may deviate from the reference and still be correct or partly correct. SERVER-ONLY: never sent to the browser.

text.description: The complete exercise text (Markdown) with each gap marked around its reference answer: [[answer]], [[answer|hint]] for a hint shown after the gap, [[]] where nothing belongs (an empty answer is correct). A gap opens and closes on one line; put gaps in ordinary sentences and list items. A literal [[ or ]] is not supported. 1 to 40 gaps, each answer at most 200 characters. The reference answers are SERVER-ONLY: students see only numbered gaps and hints.

model.description: The model that grades the answers and writes the consolidated feedback.

provider.description: The LLM provider serving the model. For Azure Foundry, model is the deployment name.

reasoning.description: Optional reasoning effort for reasoning models. Not every model accepts every level. Omit to let the model decide (the parameter is then not sent); "none" instead turns a reasoning model off.

llm.description: The single model + provider that grades the gaps and writes the feedback.

id.description: Local alias for this library, used before the dot in `{{fragment "alias.id"}}`. Must not contain a dot.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL or relative path to the fragment library.

fragmentFileRef.description: A reference to a fragment library by alias + URL.

id.description: Local alias for this text file, used in `{{file "alias"}}`. Must not contain a dot.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL or relative path to the plain-text file.

textFileRef.description: A reference to a plain-text file (markdown / source) by alias + URL.
